raw_text: Beijing has intensified its diplomatic and information campaign over the disputed territory it calls Zangnan, coinciding with PLA Eastern Theatre Command exercises. Analysts note the campaign follows a pattern of cognitive warfare designed to establish narrative dominance before potential diplomatic or military escalation along the Line of Actual Control.
clean_text: SCMP reports Beijing intensifying information campaign over Zangnan territory during PLA exercises. Analysts identify cognitive warfare pattern ahead of potential LAC escalation.
